# Zapy

> Zapy ("Turn what you save into what you do") is an Expo SDK 58 / React Native app (runs in Expo Go) with a Convex backend. It pulls in saves (links, text, photos, X bookmarks, GitHub stars), classifies each one server-side with OpenAI into one of 14 content types with evidence-quoted facts, sorts it into a box (Code, Forms, Events, Jobs, Learn, Other), and turns it into a task with three contextual actions. GitHub, form and event saves also get an approval-gated agent action: Run it for me (E2B sandbox), Fill it for me (Browserbase + Stagehand) and Add to my calendar (Composio Google Calendar). Identity is a device ownerId checked on every public Convex function.

## Key source files

- [src/shared/contracts.ts](src/shared/contracts.ts): shared types: content types, action types, ACTION_ROUTING, statuses, result documents (additive changes only)
- [src/identity/OwnerProvider.tsx](src/identity/OwnerProvider.tsx): device ownerId and the useOwnedQuery / useOwnedMutation hooks
- [src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx](src/app/%28tabs%29/index.tsx): Home, the Your tasks queue
- [src/app/welcome.tsx](src/app/welcome.tsx): start flow (questionnaire, account, calendar)
- [src/app/pull.tsx](src/app/pull.tsx): Pull everything and the six boxes
- [src/components/agents/PrimaryTaskAction.tsx](src/components/agents/PrimaryTaskAction.tsx): the big agent button per box
- [convex/schema.ts](convex/schema.ts): all tables and indexes
- [convex/http.ts](convex/http.ts): HTTP routes (OAuth callbacks, /save, /demo pages)
- [convex/lib/auth.ts](convex/lib/auth.ts): requireUser, requireOwnedItem, requireOwned
- [convex/items.ts](convex/items.ts): saves API (create, list, search, retry, upload URLs)
- [convex/ingest.ts](convex/ingest.ts): ingestion internal action (fetch, classify, extract facts)
- [convex/lib/actionCatalog.ts](convex/lib/actionCatalog.ts): the three actions per content type
- [convex/lib/executors/index.ts](convex/lib/executors/index.ts): executor registry
- [convex/demo.ts](convex/demo.ts): pullEverything, pullStatus, primaryAction
- [convex/agentMode.ts](convex/agentMode.ts): Run it for me in E2B
- [convex/formFillAgent.ts](convex/formFillAgent.ts): Fill it for me with Browserbase + Stagehand
- [convex/agents/calendar.ts](convex/agents/calendar.ts): calendar agent with approval
- [convex/imports/sync.ts](convex/imports/sync.ts): syncAll for X bookmarks and GitHub stars
- [convex/lib/llm.ts](convex/lib/llm.ts): the only OpenAI JSON helper (OPENAI_MODEL)
